cohort: Women who underwent LPS or LPT myomectomy between January 2002 and December 2014 at three institutions belonging to the University of Milano Bicocca, Italy, and had a subsequent pregnancy
finding: In women with prior myomectomy, TOLAM was successful in 90.4% of cases, with no reported uterine ruptures or severe maternal/perinatal complications, suggesting TOLAM as a feasible and relatively safe option.
mod_finding: Entry into the uterine cavity during myomectomy was significantly associated with planned cesarean delivery, suggesting obstetricians' preference for cesarean delivery in such cases.
